This [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' was a member of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Noble/Legends|aristocracy]], and a candidate for the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|throne]] in the year [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]]. He was opposed to Naboo's full intergration into the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and was supported in his campaign by [[Cosinga Palpatine]], ostensibly to protect Naboo's [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] reserves from being exploited by corporate entities. Cosinga's [[Palpatine/Legends|son]], however, regarded it as a crude, transparent attempt to grab power, as his father was engaging in an extramarital affair with the man's [[Cosinga Palpatine's mistress|sister]]. The younger Palpatine leaked details of the opponent's plans to Tapalo's camp, ultimately drawing [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]] to Naboo and destroying the campaign, and resulting in Tapalo's election as King of Naboo.<ref name="Darth P" />
